body:
Phase 1, server half one. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md.

- LIST_KINDS gains "expenses". A list's kind may never change to or from it.
- New LWW list field `currency`: free text, <= 32 chars, required non-empty
  when kind is expenses, permitted but ignored otherwise. NOT the ISO check.
- New LWW item field `expense`: {paid_by, equal_by, paid_for, equal_for, date}.
  Validation on expense lists as a unit: both maps non-empty, every value a
  positive amount in PRICE_AMOUNT_RE format (never zero), both maps sum to the
  same value in cents, every key a current member (the frozen-participant
  exception arrives with the phase-2 ticket), date YYYY-MM-DD. Null and
  required-absent on other kinds. No stored total.
- name_merge is skipped for expense lists; names are not unique there.
- schema.sql + migration; wire-contract.md; server README.
- Tests: the validation matrix, kind immutability both directions, merge
  skipped, a solo list end to end.
title: expenses: server — item field, list currency, kind rules, validation
